title: 上海高考翻译背诵-71-25一模

items.zh: AI已经慢慢融入创造性艺术,让生活充满惊喜。
items.en: Gradually integrated into creative arts, AI has made life full of surprises.

items.zh: 这部电影激发了外国观众对中国语言和文化的好奇心。
items.en: The film sparked foreign audiences’ curiosity about Chinse language and culture.

items.zh: 终身学习指的是一种自我驱动的能力提升方式,这种学习关注个人的成长且往往发生在教室之外。
items.en: Life-long learning refers to a self-driven approach to self-improvement, which focuses on personal growth and usually takes place outside the classroom.

items.zh: 这些大学生志愿者活跃在各行各业,如环境保护、健康卫生、公益教育,让我们看到了青春该有的模样。
items.en: These college volunteers are active in a wide range of fields, including environmental protection, healthcare and public welfare education, showing the true face of youth.
